targetText: Their ability to respond to the social duties of a citizen begins to have more value than their "goodness" and "stainlessness" in family-morals.
explanation: A woman's worth under socialism is evaluated by her active social contribution and revolutionary class work rather than traditional bourgeois purity standards.

targetText: There remains less and less of the old bourgeois hypocrisy in our way of thinking and judging of sex morals.
explanation: Replacing hypocritical bourgeois double standards with transparent, materialist evaluations of human behavior and work efficiency.
